description: Siniestros Viales Consolidados Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Reporte alfanúmerico de los incidentes viales registrados en los informes policiales de accidentes de tránsito ocurridos en Bogotá desde el año 2015. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría Distrital de Movilidad - SDM. Its tags are Accidente, Actor vial, Atropello, Choque, Heridos. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2021-10-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
